method: each mutant is a patched copy of tensor_cuda/tensor_cuda/apa_sp2.py and apa_packed.py under artifacts/apa_p1d/mutants/<name>/ (one replacement, which must occur exactly once in the final source); the named test runs with APA_P1D_SRC=<that dir>; killed = pytest exit 1 and the expected failure text present in the output. The unmutated source must pass the same tests first.

mutants.name: epsilon_as_delta
mutants.rule: R-D: delta comes from the upward-rounded rule, never epsilon
mutants.expected_failure: delta must be derived from epsilon and e_q

mutants.name: dense_table_on_packed
mutants.rule: R-D: a dense table with a packed object raises

mutants.name: two_bits_to_four
mutants.new: reason = packed_ineligible_reason(k, 4 if bulk_bits == 2 else bulk_bits)

mutants.name: stale_packed_keys
mutants.rule: R-C/R-D: the append generation is part of the exact-K identity
mutants.new: """R-D: raise ValueError unless k is this object's current exact K."""

mutants.name: causal_offset_dropped
mutants.rule: design (d): wrong causal handling is detected; is_causal is forwarded

mutants.name: sinks_dropped
mutants.rule: design (a)/(d): sinks keep one denominator contribution; they are forwarded
